notes.title: Weclome to Gamescom 2018 to play Another Adventure
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Gamescom 2018 will be held from Aug 21 to 25 in Cologne.

I'm cheerful to say that our game Another Adventure will be on show in WhisperGames's stand.
For those who have the chance to get to Cologne and play with us, we have prepared some gifts for you. Hope you guys like it. Haha~
